_comment: Jackson — generation-A workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Jackson, MS MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 7 MSA counties (Hinds, Madison, Rankin, Copiah, Simpson, Yazoo, Holmes), Madison (Mississippi), Rankin (Mississippi), Copiah (Mississippi), Simpson (Mississippi), Yazoo (Mississippi), Holmes (Mississippi)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 10 geocoded venue(s) of 12 in this batch (observed lat 32.2544..32.4675, lng -90.2985..-89.9409).
msa: Jackson, MS (Hinds, Madison, Rankin, Copiah, Simpson, Yazoo, Holmes counties)
_expected_publish_comment: OWNER-LOCKED 2026-08-05, authored AFTER the --stage=project projection was read and approved unchanged, never before. Both project and publish assert against this block and fail the run on any divergence, and reportExpected says in as many words 'Fix the pipeline. Do NOT edit the expectation to match the output.' The count moves 6 -> 10 with no re-import and no new research: the four rows released (Towne Park, Ridgeland Tennis Center, The Club at The Township, Madison Methodist Church) were held ONLY on location_precision 'low', which ADR-16 retired as a gate condition. Each was checked to be anchored on the correct named street in the correct city before approval — they publish behind the ADR-16 approximate-location label, which is the intended behavior and not a compromise. The two rows that remain held are the last genuine coordinate-based holds in this batch; both carry a CONFIRMED-correct street address (Magnolia against the operator's own site, Cascades against the Clinton Chamber directory), so each is a geocoding failure rather than a research failure, and a later re-geocode releases it without touching this block.
